author_doubts_decisions.decision: Changed. The prompt must ask for the scene. Added "Vertel wat u ziet." to all 11 picture-describe prompts whose C0 is "Vertel wat u op het plaatje ziet.". Reason: with hidden criteria the learner cannot know a separate scene sentence is scored; the samples show C0 is meant as a distinct scene sentence; OpenExercise.tsx states the prompt must name everything the criteria check; the 063 items already ask one sentence per criterion; the clips are regenerated anyway. The overlap with C1 is harmless: a scene sentence that also names the things meets both.
Accepted. A starter that supplies the verb of the action a criterion asks the picture to show is the same leak as naming the place. The 15 starter-only records stay.
